Market today: The bond market seems to be trusting Fed speak, leading to lower volatility. This is generally good for risk assets, but your concentrated tech/chip book is still feeling the pinch.

Your holdings: SOXL is still a major concern at -56.24%. SMH and QQQI are also in the red and flagged for attention. CRWD is your only real winner.

Watch: Keep an eye on the 2-year Treasury yield, which jumped on Fed comments.

Bottom line: You're heavily exposed to leveraged tech, and any whiff of hawkishness from the Fed will hurt.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this leveraged position given the -56.24% loss and decay risk.
SMH: Respect the $540 stop. If it breaks, consider trimming.
No new buys today - hold and watch
